svg.title: Personal software projects
svg.desc: Shot-Counter synchronises devices; Claude Code Kit checks a code change. One tap. Every screen. Shot-Counter connects phones and a shared scoreboard. QR joining, live sync and a desktop app. Vue 3 / Express / SQLite / Electron A workflow, packaged. Claude Code Kit: reusable skills and specialist agents for project upkeep, creative frontends and security reviews. Custom skills / Agents / AI workflows
